title: NHS Board or Trust
summary: Adds value streams — Patient Journey, Learn & Improve Care, and Diagnose & Treat — grouping v1 capabilities by the outcome patients experience.
sourceDescription: Starter capability map for an NHS board or trust, v2: adds value streams (ADR-023) — Patient Journey, Learn & Improve Care, Diagnose & Treat — grouping v1 capabilities by the outcome patients experience. Capability items are unchanged from v1 (codes 1-12). Stream content was drafted this sprint (F6) for the reviewer; reviewed by Simon Parkinson, 2026-09-21. Stream names and descriptions revised 2026-11-10 (Claude Code, for consistency across maps); pending re-review.

sources.citation: NHS England enterprise-architecture business capability model (consulted for scope and level-1 shape; not copied)
Health and Care Act 2022 and the National Health Service (Scotland) Act 1978 (statutory duties consulted for sector-specific capabilities)
UK Government Functional Standards GovS 001-016 (consulted for the shared corporate capabilities)

valueStreams.name: Patient Journey
valueStreams.description: Starts when a patient is referred. Ends when they are discharged and recovering.

valueStreams.name: Learn & Improve Care
valueStreams.description: Starts when an incident or a clinical question arises. Ends when the lesson is learned and care is improved.

valueStreams.name: Diagnose & Treat
valueStreams.description: Starts when a clinician requests a test or treatment. Ends when results, medicines or equipment are delivered to the patient.
